text: Seven-oh-two a.m. Your phone buzzes.
Plus one dollar. Sender: unknown. Memo... your name.
Nev! Breakfast!
Ding. Another dollar.
Nev?
Nev! Nev! Nev! Nev!
So what if you earned one dollar... every time someone said your name?
Okay. First, you test it.
Nev. Nev... Nev!
Nothing. Your own voice doesn't count.
Texting it doesn't count either. It has to be said out loud. By someone else.
So you call the one person who will do anything for free food.
Wait. You'll buy me tacos if I just say your name? Nev. Nev. Nev! Nev, Nev, Nev!
Six dollars.
Bro, this is the easiest job I've ever had! Nev! Nev-Nev-Nev! Hahaha!
By lunch, Jake has said your name two hundred and forty times. You buy him three tacos. You're still up two hundred and thirty bucks.
Day three. You figure out the real trick.
Names spread.
You sign up for the school talent show. Your act? You just... stand there.
And the whole gym chants.
Nev! Nev! Nev! Nev!
Four hundred kids. Ninety seconds. Plus... eleven thousand dollars.
Somebody films it. By Friday, it's a trend.
Hashtag Say Nev. Fourteen million views.
Kids in Ohio. A grandma in Texas. A guy on a fishing boat in Alaska.
Everybody is saying your name.
And your phone... never stops buzzing.
Day nine. One million, two hundred eighty-four thousand dollars.
You buy your mom a new car. You buy Jake a lifetime supply of tacos.
I'm not crying. You're crying! Hahaha.
Then, Monday morning... Jake doesn't laugh.
Bro... my bank account. It's empty. Like, zero. I had two hundred and forty dollars yesterday.
Two hundred and forty dollars.
The exact number of times he said your name.
You check the transfers. Every single one has a sender. They're not coming from nowhere.
Every time someone says your name... the dollar comes out of their pocket.
Honey, my card got declined at the grocery store. That's weird, right?
She said your name eleven times this week. Calling you for dinner.
Fourteen million people said Nev. Fourteen million people are one dollar poorer. And they're starting to notice.
Breaking news. Thousands of Americans report a mysterious one-dollar charge... every time they say one name.
By Wednesday... nobody says your name anymore.
Student fourteen. Present?
Hey... dude. Hey, you. Uh... buddy.
Your best friend won't say your name.
Your mom calls you sweetheart now. Kiddo. Champ. Anything but Nev.
The counter stops.
And for the first time in your life... you realize how good it felt to just hear it.
So you open the bank app. Fourteen million, two hundred thousand transfers.
There's a button you never noticed. Return all.
Your thumb shakes.
It's every dollar you have.
You press it.
Across America, fourteen million phones buzz at once. Plus one dollar. Memo: sorry.
Nev?
It's the first time in a week anyone has said it.
Your phone doesn't buzz. Plus nothing. Minus nothing.
It's just your name again.
Nev! Dinner! Love you, kiddo.
Nev! Nev! Nev! Bro, it's free now! I'm gonna say it all day! Hahaha!
That night, at three thirty-three a.m., your phone lights up one last time.
Plus one dollar. Sender: unknown. Memo... Jake.
Wait. Why did I just get a dollar?
Whose name would YOU want to get paid for? Tell us in the comments.
